first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is also declining. Prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding improved time-to-value and completion, while fewer signup fields improved SMB activation. I would run a limited simplification test, monitoring qualified pipeline, activation quality, and retention—not just completion—with explicit stop conditions if downstream value deteriorates.

final.rationale: Run a standard, randomized onboarding-simplification experiment this week, focused on reversing the 4% completion decline and improving activation. The archived result is confirmed: shorter onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Track qualified revenue, activation quality, and 30-day retention with stop conditions for downstream deterioration. Do not generalize the signup-field reduction despite its SMB activation lift, because it reduced retention by 1% and has not replicated outside SMB.
